evidence.raw_reports: The node-owned paths below retain raw samples, correctness, source and NCU CSV. This Finding is curated interpretation, not another evaluation or promotion ledger.

observation: Seven fixed-shape three-way comparisons passed all 210 numerical pre/postflight checks. 003 has a stable external gap: 14.368 us Cake versus 3.040 us derived external, while the separate optimized/starter edge is 1.542x. Its sealed source changes BLOCK_COLUMNS 1024 to 2048 but keeps one warp and 64 CTAs; NCU observes 0.55% active warps versus 3.32% for the external 448-thread CTA, with zero local-memory load/store sectors in both. 022 packs four rows into one 32-thread CTA: 135 CTAs, 80 registers/thread and 0.89% active warps, versus starter 539 CTAs, 45 registers/thread and 1.84%. The 022 starter beats its supplied reference by a quality-passing 1.151x; the selected rewrite is slower in the retained descriptive measurements. 001/002/025 match the external block/grid geometry after width tuning, but measured L2 traffic is respectively about 20%, 30% and 16% higher. Their external timing edges fail the original CV gate, so these are attribution leads rather than qualified exact slowdown claims. 021 retains the starter work assignment and has a quality-passing null result against it. All 18 profiled participants launch one kernel and show zero local-memory sectors: no evidence here attributes the gaps to extra kernel launches or spills.
proposed_change: Keep the original starter artifacts as cross-version anchors and judge external parity separately. First isolate 003 CTA width with existing specialize_triton_warps, then compare the existing masked whole-row formulation against its sliced reduction. For 022, retain the faster starter as an incumbent and evaluate row packing jointly with execution groups. For 001/002/025, test existing LoadReuse streamed/reused declarations and inspect emitted vector loads/stores before proposing new IR; keep precision and output gates fixed. Do not equate a report-qualified candidate with a speedup or promotion. No new Compiler primitive/pass is justified by this snapshot alone, and profiler correlation is not an isolated causal ablation.

measurement_boundary.timing: Three independent paired edges; 10 alternating pairs, 25 samples per arm/cohort, 42 checked calls per cohort; strict CUPTI device-activity span and cold L2; maximum cohort CV 0.05 unchanged. Host dispatch, compilation and preparation are excluded.
measurement_boundary.correctness: Five task-owned distributions for all three participants before and after timing; 30 checks per task. NCU separately checks five cases and its profiled output for each participant.
measurement_boundary.external_changes: 001/002/004 keep supplied source, using explicitly recorded C++20 build compatibility. 003 is a separately identified host Graph-argument correction; original 003 remains failed. 021/022/025 keep supplied Python source.
measurement_boundary.profile: Separate NCU 2025.4.1 kernel replay with cache-control all. Counters support attribution; profiler duration is not substituted for paired timing. Six tasks x three participants; 90 case checks plus 18 profiled-output checks.
measurement_boundary.scope: One fixed shape per task, one retained comparison run, no serving claim, no leaderboard aggregate, no provider-arm comparison and no promotion. 005/023/024/026 successors and 012-020 multi-stage authoring are outside this completed comparison set.

promotion_disposition: No promotion; existing Compiler mechanisms and Lab selection are the next experimental owners.

renumbered_from.reason: NVIDIA integration found the same date/sequence already used by main provider-protocol findings; original evidence remains at the pinned commit.

followup_observation: Three subsequent external comparisons complete 005, 023 (h1536) and 024: all 90 pre/postflight checks passed, bringing this record to 10 tasks and 300 such checks. Their optimized-versus-external timing edges each fail the unchanged CV gate. 024 improves on its old starter by 2.475x with qualified timing; 005 is 5.6 percent slower than its old starter with qualified timing, so keep the starter and return that seed to optimization. 023 has only a descriptive external lead. These are additional historical-source comparisons, not measurements of the new guarded alignment implementation.

work_assignment_followup.source_scope: Complete authored Schedules through the existing Compiler, not an expanded specialize_triton_warps pass. The pass still refuses TileLoop. Width variants change only execution_groups and the nominal Schedule id; width one retains the original Schedule mechanisms under the current compiler. No alignment treatment.
work_assignment_followup.measurement_boundary: Original oracle and all input/output checks; 2550 complete snapshots per run, five distributions, 10 alternating pairs per edge, 25 timed samples and 42 checked calls per cohort, cold-L2 CUPTI, one continuous exclusive allocation for all three edges. CPU preparation and bulk validation are outside that allocation. CV and materiality remain 0.05.
work_assignment_followup.control_boundary: 003 uses its frozen old optimized binary; 022 uses its faster original single-row starter. A width-one recompilation measures current-compiler floor separately. The original task starters are retained at their previous paths. 003 external remains the explicitly derived Graph-host-argument correction; 022 external is unchanged.
work_assignment_followup.interpretation: 003 width-one new/old is quality-passing close_null (1.023x), so this run establishes no material compiler-floor improvement. Width four and sixteen beat the old control on qualified edges (1.463x and 2.125x), but their external edges fail CV. Width changes are candidate tuning, not a new Compiler mechanism. 022 width four beats the external on a qualified 1.164x edge; no tested width has a quality-passing improvement over the retained original starter. Preserve that starter. A valid individual edge does not qualify the whole three-edge report.
work_assignment_followup.promotion_disposition: No promotion. Retain failed timing edges and pending numerical verification. Next structural candidate replaces the sliced/reloading 003 computation with an existing masked whole-row formulation at the same width; profiler attribution is still separate.

work_assignment_completion.interpretation: 003 width eight also beats the frozen old optimized control on a qualified edge: 10.368 versus 14.496 us, 1.398x. Its external edge fails CV. Width-dependent improvement is not monotonic. All seven runs now pass their 2550 complete numerical snapshots; only 003 width one has all three timing edges quality-passing. Six full reports remain measurement_quality_failed. Individual qualified edges retain their own scope. No promotion.
